james_nybridge: Hi team — NYBridge here. We're finalizing a SIG/CAIQ for a regulator and a few items were flagged. Need confirmation by Tue 2026-05-05 EOD: (1) data retention policy + S3 audit logs export, (2) KMS/HSM key custody and rotation evidence, (3) bespoke CAIQ answers and a signed attestation for key management. Can you confirm what artifacts you can provide and how long it will take?

sarah_cs: Thanks James — looping in Security & Eng. Quick q: is this for Hosted API only or do you also have Dedicated/Private? Also can you paste the exact questions flagged?

james_nybridge: Hosted API only. Flagged items: Q3.4.1 (key management lifecycle), Q5.2.2 (log retention policy + retention period), and a bespoke ask for a signed attestation stating Redwood holds and rotates keys and that we do not export key material. Auditor sent an example form — here's a copy: https://example.com/nybridge-auditor-sample (redacted)

sarah_cs: Got it. @olga_security can you advise on HSM attestation & what KMS metadata we can export for hosted customers? Also we may need an evidence pack (PDF) + redacted logs.

olga_security: We can provide: a) attestation letter describing our key custody model for hosted keys; b) KMS metadata CSV (key id, creation_ts, last_rotate_ts, key_origin, key_spec); c) export of CloudTrail events filtered for KMS and S3 audit events (CreateKey, RotateKey, Encrypt, Decrypt, PutObject, DeleteObject, ConsoleLogin). Note: we never export HSM private material. For HSM-backed keys we can include vendor metadata (e.g., LunaCloud) and firmware versions if requested. We need ~72 hours to assemble and perform PII redaction. :white_check_mark:

mike_engineer: I'm queuing an extraction job for the audit buckets. Draft command I used for a scoped pull (will redact names/emails after):

```bash
# pull last 90 days of CloudTrail S3 prefix for nybridge scope
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-logs/cloudtrail/nybridge/ ./nybridge-cloudtrail --recursive --exclude '*' --include '2026-0[1-3]*' --profile redwood-export
```

I'll also run a filter to extract kms events: `jq 'select(.eventSource=="kms.amazonaws.com")' *.json > nybridge-kms-events.json`

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-8423 — cs-evidence-export (assigned to sarah_cs, olga_security, mike_engineer)

sarah_cs: Proposed plan: (A) Tailored CAIQ answers + attestation letter (PDF) by Fri 2026-04-10; (B) Redacted logs export (SFTP or presigned S3) by Mon 2026-04-13; (C) KMS metadata CSV with rotation history by Mon 2026-04-13. Delivery will be via secure SFTP unless you prefer presigned S3 links. Can you confirm delivery preference and whether we should include MD5 checksums? :shipit:

james_nybridge: SFTP preferred. Please include MD5 checksums and a short cover note we can hand to our regulator confirming scope + permitted use. Also include a small CSV mapping KMS key ids to the CAIQ questions they satisfy if possible.

olga_security: SFTP works. We'll include an attestation with legal scope language. Quick note: for the attestation to reference vendor HSM firmware versions or a vendor-signed attestation we may need a letter of request from your legal team — I'll DM you the required wording.

sarah_cs: I'll create a calendar invite for a 15-min handoff and drop the CS ticket with milestones. Thanks everyone — we'll flag if any blockers.

james_nybridge: Great, appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll watch for SFTP details and the calendar invite.
